segments.text:
V. 16.
The Herodians, were a Set of Men peculiarly attached to Herod, and conſequently zealous for the Intereſt of the Roman Government, which was the main Support of the Dignity and Royalty of his Family. Thou regardeſt not the perſon of men—Thou favoureſt no Man for his Riches or Greatneſs.
